title: Bigfoot? Missouri Homesteader Finds Curious Trail Cam Photo
excerpt: A Missouri homesteader has just shared video that reveals a trail cam picture he believes shows a Bigfoot creature.
content:
A Missouri homesteader who had a family member place a trail cam deep in the woods far away from regular trails has captured a photo that he believes may just be the ever elusive Bigfoot creature.

Homestead Horsemanship on YouTube is not known for frequent cryptid reports. They normally document their lifestyle which includes living in the Missouri Ozarks and horses, as you might imagine. He doesn't mention exactly where he lives, but he does say it's in the Missouri Ozarks. A new video they shared just days ago shows something else entirely. He believes it's a Bigfoot creature caught reaching around the trail camera before it was removed from the tree. Note, he shows the photo near the end of his video.

Several important facts to consider:

  • The trail camera was removed from the tree, but nothing including the memory card was stolen which means it was likely not a human thief
  • The camera was placed high enough in the tree that a human arm wearing a costume would likely have no way to reach it
  • The camera is infrared which he believes these creatures can see which is why they avoid walking directly in front of these cameras

I don't know if this Missouri homesteader really did capture a photo of a Bigfoot creature, but I believe that he's sincere. You never see him share content like this to get attention. Whatever furry arm is pictured on his camera is certifiably odd. Whether it's a Bigfoot is for you to decide.
